data.one_liner: Flutter package providing Feather icon set as font maps and camel/snake case accessors.
data.what_it_does: It exposes Feather icons as a map of font codes and convenient camelCase and snake_case getters. The icons are bundled as a font and can be used directly in Text widgets or Icon widgets.
use_when: You need a lightweight, open‑source icon set for a Flutter app.
You prefer to access icons via code rather than asset images.
You want null‑safe icon accessors without extra dependencies.
avoid_when: You already use another comprehensive icon package like Font Awesome or Material Symbols.
You need icons that are not part of the Feather set.
weaknesses: Limited to Feather icon set only
No vector asset support beyond font
No custom icon styling beyond font weight

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a similar icon set with more icons and active maintenance

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a larger, widely used icon collection
